description: A small toy kitchen is on a tabletop, with a gray refrigerator door next to a microwave/oven unit, and a bunch of green grapes and a red apple nearby. The right hand reaches up to the refrigerator handle and pulls the door outward while the left hand steadies near the lower edge; then the right hand picks up the grapes and places them onto the upper shelf inside, followed by lifting the apple and setting it in the fridge as well before the hand withdraws.
